description: This file contains the implementation of the DeleteThingLiveCommand in the Eclipse Ditto project. It defines an immutable class that represents a delete command for a 'thing' in a live signal context, providing methods to create instances, set headers, and identify the command category.

classes.name: DeleteThingLiveCommandImpl
classes.description: An immutable implementation of the DeleteThingLiveCommand interface, representing a delete command for a 'thing' in the live signals context.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new instance of DeleteThingLiveCommandImpl from a general Command object, casting it to DeleteThing.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Returns the category of the command, which is DELETE.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Creates a new instance of DeleteThingLiveCommandImpl with specified DittoHeaders.

methods.name: changesAuthorization
methods.description: Indicates whether the command changes authorization; returns false.

methods.name: answer
methods.description: Returns a builder for constructing responses to this command.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the object.
